query:
*[_type == "ticketsPage"][0]{
    title,
    intro,
    buyButtonLabel,
    soldOutMessage,
    salesClosedMessage,
    termsNote,
    confirmationPendingHeading,
    confirmationPendingMessage,
    confirmationSuccessHeading,
    confirmationSuccessMessage,
    confirmationNotFoundMessage,
    ticketIncludesNote,
    cancelledHeading,
    cancelledMessage,
    cancelledButtonLabel
  }

result.cancelledMessage: No payment was taken. Your reservation has been left open — you're welcome to try again whenever you're ready.
result.confirmationNotFoundMessage: We couldn't find a booking for that reference. If you've just paid, check the confirmation link or contact info@saoc.co.za.
result.confirmationPendingMessage: We're still waiting for payment confirmation from PayFast. This usually takes a few seconds — please don't refresh or submit payment again. This page will update automatically.
result.confirmationSuccessMessage: Thank you — your payment is confirmed and your spot at the SAOC National Show is secured.
result.intro: Secure your seat at the SAOC National Show — South Africa's premier orchid exhibition, bringing together growers, judges and orchid lovers from across the country.
result.salesClosedMessage: Tickets for the 2027 National Show are not yet on sale — check back soon.
result.termsNote: Admission tickets may be transferred to another attendee by emailing info@saoc.co.za before the show. Please bring your booking reference to the door.
result.ticketIncludesNote: Your ticket includes full-day entry to the National Show floor, access to the judging galleries, and entry to all exhibitor stages.
result.title: Get Your Tickets
